svg.aria-label: emetgate: A gate between a coding model and your source tree. A change reaches disk only if the checks pass. Drawn as a star cluster with one star for each of its 998 commits and a brighter star for each of its 14 published versions. 998 commits, since Sep 2026, release v0.6.0.
